portfolios.committee: Global Space Policy and Trade Council (GSPTC)
portfolios.purpose: Founded 1998. It does not build rockets; it arranges flights. It arranged all nine private-citizen flights to the ISS, all on Russia's Soyuz.
bodies: UNOOSA: Outer Space Treaty (1967), Rescue Agreement (1968), Liability Convention (1972), Registration Convention (1975), and COPUOS documents
FAA Office of Commercial Space Transportation
NASA private astronaut missions and the Artemis Accords
India: IN-SPACe and Indian Space Policy 2023
laws: 51 U.S.C. Chapter 509, Commercial Space Launch Act
The FAA cannot regulate passenger safety on board until the moratorium ends 1 January 2028
notes: For contrast: Axiom Space, Virgin Galactic investor reports, Blue Origin.

portfolios.purpose: Paris-based medtech firm founded 2014. It makes AI-assisted EEG, sleep (PSG) and cardiology diagnostics with connected wearables (IceCap and Neuronaute+), CE and FDA cleared.
portfolios.bestAngle: Who owns and controls biometric and brain data, and how AI is used on it.
primary: FDA 510(k) clearance K231366 for Neuronaute Plus, accessdata.fda.gov
bodies: WHO, Ethics and Governance of AI for Health (2021) and the Human Genome Editing governance framework (2021)
FDA Digital Health Center of Excellence
WADA Prohibited List, which bans gene doping
Council of Europe Oviedo Convention on biomedicine
laws: EU GDPR: health data is a special category

portfolios.committee: World Council on Future Food and Health

primary: palantir.com, product and sector pages, Healthcare
investors.palantir.com, annual report and 10-K, risk factors on regulation
